'''Daxarn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[Invasion of Belsavis]] around [[3641 BBY]] he was stationed in the [[High Security Section]] of the [[Belsavis prison]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Master Daxarn appears in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a rare champion spawn that appears in the High Security Section.

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Strongholds]]'' {{1st}}
